mapper.select: SELECT available_amount FROM account_wallet WHERE openid = #{userId} AND currency = 'CNY' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE account_wallet w LEFT JOIN user_account u ON u.openid = w.openid SET w.available_amount = w.available_amount - #{amount}, w.update_time = now() WHERE w.openid = #{userId} AND w.currency = 'CNY' AND w.available_amount >= #{amount} AND (u.openid IS NULL OR u.status = 0)
UPDATE account_wallet SET available_amount = available_amount + #{amount}, update_time = now() WHERE openid = #{userId} AND currency = 'CNY'
